issues.detail: The Greek word 'βασιλειαν' (basileian) means 'kingdom', but the Vietnamese translation uses 'nước' (which can mean country/nation) and 'có nước' (has water/country), which fails to convey the specific concept of 'kingdom'. Furthermore, 'có nước trên các vua' is grammatically awkward and misses the sense of 'having a kingdom over/above'.
